title: OverSire store
description: The records of the state that OverSire owns. Each record type is one collection. Dates are ISO 8601.

runbook.description: The Runbook id (runbook.json) that the start runs. Absent: one session.

QueueLane.description: Collection queue-lanes. The id is the project.

project.description: The store key of the project.

QueueLaneState.description: Collection queue-lane-state. The id is the project. The queue writes it, not the user.

project.description: The store key of the project.

lastStarted.description: Item key of the last start in the lane.

QueueTrigger.description: Collection queue-triggers. The id is the key.

IgnoredFailure.description: Collection ignored-failures. The id is the run URL, #, and the attempt.

Note.description: Collection notes. A private note. It does not go to the vendor.

AgentLink.description: Collection agent-links. The id is the key.

ItemAreas.description: Collection item-areas. The code areas of one item. The id is the store key of the item: <ProjectRef.storeKey>/<item id>. Area tags live only here, not as tracker labels.

suggestion.description: The Suggestion id when the source is suggestion.

PlannerSettings.description: Collection planner-settings. The Planner settings of one project. The id is the project.

project.description: The store key of the project, the same as QueueLane.project.

mode.description: off: no plan job; the gate still holds orders. hourly: at most one plan change each hour. live: a plan change about 2 minutes after a change. Open set: an unknown mode acts as hourly.

holdLimit.description: Seconds. A held order older than this is a heldLong trigger.

triggers.description: The PlannerTrigger kinds that wake the Planner. Missing: all.

sharedFeature.description: serial: two items do not hold the same feature area at the same time. parallel: they can. Core areas are always serial.

slots.description: The number of items that run at the same time.

AreaRule.description: A path rule of an area. The glob matches a path relative to the repo root: * is one path part, ** is any number of parts.

source.description: user wins over learned and graph.

proposed.description: True: the hub proposes the area from the import graph. The user accepts it in Settings. Missing: false.

AreaCatalog.description: Collection area-catalog. The code areas of one project. The id is the project.

project.description: The store key of the project.

AreaClaim.description: Collection area-claims. The areas that a running item holds. The id is the ItemAreas id of the item. Only the gate writes it.

grown.description: The areas that the claim got after the start, from the changed paths.

blocked.description: Areas outside the claim that an other claim holds. The next order of the item waits.

by.description: For a blocked area: the item that holds it.

AreaCandidates.description: Collection area-candidates. Area candidates from the import graph of the repos of one project, made on the Mac. The id is the project. Only paths, no code.

hubs.description: Files or folders that many files import. Core area candidates.

clusters.description: Groups of files that import each other. Feature area candidates.

importers.description: The number of files that import it.

ChangedPaths.description: Collection changed-paths. The paths that the running work of one subject changed: git diff against the base plus untracked files. Only paths, never file text. The id is the ItemAreas id of the item, or the session key.

AIOutput.description: Collection ai-outputs. The result of one automatic AI job. The Macs of the user share it, so only the app that owns the automations runs the job (OVERSIRE-327). The id is <kind>:<subject>. hash is the hash of the job input: a record with another hash does not count for a new input. body is the app form of the result.

kind.description: Open set: item-summary, ci-explanation, ci-digest, session-status, enhance-written (the mark that Enhance wrote its review to the item), groom-review (the Groom result of a project, until Apply or Discard).

subject.description: An item key, a run key or a day.

AgentEnvVar.description: One env row of an agent. A secret row has no value: the value is on the home daemon (daemon.json AgentSecretSet). A value can hold the placeholders {name}, {KEY}, {key} and {title}.

AgentDef.description: Collection agents. One shared agent: on all the Macs of the user. The id is the agent name. The id * holds the env for all agents and only uses env. The env of an agent wins over the env for all agents.

cli.description: The base CLI: an AgentBinder Harness raw value. Absent: a terminal-only agent.

command.description: The start command template. Absent: the default of the CLI.

model.description: Absent: Auto, the default of the CLI.

effort.description: Absent: Auto. Open set: low, medium, high, max.

runsOn.description: The machine names that can start the agent. Absent: any machine.

updatedBy.description: The machine of the last edit.

StoreOp.description: One write to a synced collection. The hub keeps an op log of them. Last write wins for each collection and id, by hlc.

schema.description: The x-oversire-schema number of store.json that the writer uses.

record.description: The record of a put. Missing for a delete.

hlc.description: Hybrid clock: milliseconds since 1970 (15 digits), a counter (6 digits) and the device id. The text order is the time order.

device.description: The device id of the writer.
